Title: A sensible question about First Tradition

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
In order to get away from the hijacked thread, and my $5 question
about Madness, here's a quite simple question about First Tradition:

If you have played Malkavian Dementia, and you are presented with
the choice of taking your turn or not due to First Trad in play,
do you still return the stolen Malk even if you choose not to take
your turn?

Similarly, do you replace "do not replace until your next untap
phase" cards before you make the choice?

If you have attempted to withdraw, and have met the conditions,
do you succeed at withdrawing before making the choice?

Thanks.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
> In order to get away from the hijacked thread, and my $5 question
> about Madness, here's a quite simple question about First Tradition:
>
> If you have played Malkavian Dementia, and you are presented with
> the choice of taking your turn or not due to First Trad in play,
> do you still return the stolen Malk even if you choose not to take
> your turn?

No. You keep control of the Malk until your next untap phase, by card text.

> Similarly, do you replace "do not replace until your next untap
> phase" cards before you make the choice?

No, similarly.

> If you have attempted to withdraw, and have met the conditions,
> do you succeed at withdrawing before making the choice?

No. You would succeed, however, by choosing to take your turn (success coming
before you would later be required to burn 2 pool to the First Tradition).
